name: Sling Bullet
summary: Ammunition for Slings; sold 20 at a time.
text: One piece of ammunition for Slings. A bundle of 20 costs 4 CP and weighs 1.5 lb.; it is usually kept in a Pouch, bought separately. Each attack with an Ammunition weapon uses one piece. After a fight, spending 1 minute lets you recover half of the pieces you used (round down); the rest are lost.
